items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: We used to hang out. And we ended up playing together in his father’s club called the North End Lounge

ctx.x: Did they have any programs at that time that were — addressed jazz? Or were you more learning the classical theory and so forth?

Just basic classical theory. Because back then, when I was back there they hadn’t even started these jazz colleges and universities yet. But at that time in Baltimore, Maryland it was very, very musical. And all the jazz groups used to come down and play on Pennsylvania Avenue and so Baltimore was kind of like New York because you had the — New York had the Apollo Theater. And Baltimore, the same groups would come and do the Royal Theater in Baltimore, then they would go to Washington, DC and do the Howard…
What would your set list have been like, playing with Gary Bartz at that time?
